verdict.rationale: Trilegal is a full-service Indian law firm, not a software product, so being driven through a documented public API is a category error for this kind of product. The llms.txt index and the web-based DPDPA assessment tool are informational web content, not a programmatic interface. The OpenAPI probe found nothing (all paths 404), and nothing in the evidence suggests the firm ships an API that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
